# Will — Official Site

> Will is a Miami-based singer-songwriter blending soul, indie pop, and Latin rhythms. Albums: First Light (2019), Biscayne Nights (2022), Neon Tide (2025).

## Sections
- [About Me](https://www.willmusic.example/#about): Biography and FAQ.
- [Career](https://www.willmusic.example/#career): Timeline of milestones and releases.
- [Upcoming Shows](https://www.willmusic.example/#shows): Neon Tide Tour, Fall 2026.
- [Merch](https://www.willmusic.example/#merch): Official apparel, vinyl, and posters.
- [Fan Club](https://www.willmusic.example/#fan-club): Free "Tide Crew" membership with presales and discounts.
- [Socials](https://www.willmusic.example/#socials): Instagram, YouTube, Spotify, TikTok, X.

- 2026-10-31 — House of Blues Orlando, Lake Buena Vista, FL
